t.fr: Des hôtels en bord de mer de l'autre côté de la baie de Tokyo.

d.en: Coastal hotels around Kisarazu and the Bōsō peninsula, with views back to Mount Fuji and easy access to Tokyo. A calm seaside alternative.

fly.en: Tokyo Haneda (HND), about 45 minutes via the Aqua-Line.

when.en: March to May and October to November.

stay.en: Hand-picked hotels, villas and resorts we know well, chosen for space to work and to connect.
